name: GetAccount
label: Get Salesforce Account
description: Retrieves a single Account record from Salesforce by its ID.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Account'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Get'.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Account to retrieve (required).

fields.name: AccountData
fields.label: Retrieved Account
fields.description: The retrieved Account data as a JSON string.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
